mapper.sql: l.id, l.org_id, o.path AS org_path, o.name AS org_name, o.org_type, l.user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.account, u.employee_no, u.status AS user_status, l.leader_type, l.duty_title, l.category, l.sort_no, l.remark, l.effective_from, l.effective_to
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_org_leader l JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = l.org_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org_leader, alias=ol) */ AND l.org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY (l.leader_type = 'primary') DESC, l.sort_no ASC, l.id ASC

SELECT FROM sys_org_leader l JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = l.org_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org_leader, alias=ol) */ AND l.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT l.id, l.org_id, l.user_id, l.leader_type, l.duty_title, l.category, l.sort_no, l.effective_from, l.effective_to, l.remark, l.created_at, l.created_by, l.updated_at, l.updated_by FROM sys_org_leader l WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org_leader, alias=ol) */ AND l.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM sys_org_leader l JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = l.org_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org_leader, alias=ol) */ AND l.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.path ASC, l.category ASC, l.id ASC

SELECT FROM sys_org_leader l JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = l.org_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org_leader, alias=ol) */ AND l.category IS NOT NULL AND o.org_type = 'group' ORDER BY l.category ASC, (l.leader_type = 'primary') DESC, l.sort_no ASC, l.id ASC

SELECT l.id, l.org_id, l.user_id, l.leader_type, l.duty_title, l.category, l.sort_no, l.effective_from, l.effective_to, l.remark, l.created_at, l.created_by, l.updated_at, l.updated_by FROM sys_org_leader l WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org_leader, alias=ol) */ AND l.org_id = #{orgId} AND l.category <=> #{category} ORDER BY (l.leader_type = 'primary') DESC, l.sort_no ASC, l.id ASC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name, u.account, u.employee_no, u.status AS user_status, up.org_id, up.position, up.is_primary, l.id AS leader_id, l.leader_type, l.category, l.duty_title FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_position up ON up.user_id = u.id AND up.org_id = #{orgId} LEFT JOIN sys_org_leader l ON l.org_id = #{orgId} AND l.user_id = u.id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_user, alias=u) */ AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.status <> 'resigned' AND (u.org_id = #{orgId} OR up.id IS NOT NULL)
AND (u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.name ASC, u.id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT l.org_id FROM sys_org_leader l WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org_leader, alias=ol) */ AND l.leader_type = 'primary' AND l.category IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_org_leader l WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org_leader, alias=ol) */ AND l.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_org_leader (org_id, user_id, leader_type, duty_title, category, sort_no, effective_from, effective_to, remark, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{userId}, IFNULL(#{leaderType}, 'primary'), #{dutyTitle}, #{category}, IFNULL(#{sortNo}, 0), #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_org_leader SET leader_type = #{leaderType}, duty_title = #{dutyTitle}, category = #{category}, sort_no = IFNULL(#{sortNo}, 0), effective_from = #{effectiveFrom}, effective_to = #{effectiveTo}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_org_leader SET sort_no = IFNULL(#{sortNo}, 0), remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_org_leader l JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = l.org_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org_leader, alias=ol) */ ORDER BY o.path ASC, (l.leader_type = 'primary') DESC, l.sort_no ASC, l.id ASC
